title: Generalist Vision-Language Models for Fast Radio Burst detection: a zero-shot benchmark against a specialized detector
abstract: arXiv:2607.07382v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fast Radio Burst (FRB) detection increasingly relies on specialized deep learning models that require large task-specific training sets and cannot be redefined without retraining. We evaluate whether small, open-weight, locally run generalist Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can detect FRBs in dynamic spectra under a zero-shot, prompt-only regime. On a balanced binary benchmark of 2000 simulated L-band spectra, Gemma 4 E2B reaches an accuracy of 94.05\%, statistically indistinguishable from the specialized detector SwinYNet (92.85\%), with a far lower false-positive rate on structured RFI (4.8\% vs. 24.6\%) and none on pure noise, though SwinYNet ranks perfectly (ROC-AUC 1.0000 vs. 0.9520). Rewriting the prompt alone reconfigures the same models for three-class FRB/RFI/noise classification, reaching up to 86.0\% accuracy without a single false FRB while classifying each 2 s spectrum in 1.0--1.5 s, faster than the observation itself. translated_title: 面向快速射电暴检测的通用视觉-语言模型：与专用检测器的零样本基准对比
translated_abstract: 快速射电暴（FRB）检测日益依赖需要大量特定任务训练集且无法在不重新训练的情况下重新定义的专用深度学习模型。我们评估了小型、开放权重、本地运行的通用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能否在零样本、仅提示（prompt-only）模式下检测动态频谱中的快速射电暴。在一个包含2000个模拟L波段频谱的平衡二分类基准上，Gemma 4 E2B达到了94.05%的准确率，与专用检测器SwinYNet（92.85%）在统计上无显著差异，并且在结构化射频干扰（RFI）上的假阳性率远低（4.8%对比24.6%），在纯噪声上为零假阳性，尽管SwinYNet在排序上表现完美（ROC-AUC 1.0000对比0.9520）。仅通过重写提示即可将相同模型重新配置为三类FRB/RFI/噪声分类，最高达到86.0%的准确率且无任何虚假FRB，同时每个2秒频谱的分类耗时1.0-1.5秒，快于观测本身。
tldr: 本研究表明，小型通用视觉-语言模型在零样本条件下即可达到与专用FRB检测器相当的准确率，且通过简单修改提示即可灵活适配多类任务，无需重新训练。
en_tdlr: This study shows that small generalist vision-language models can achieve accuracy comparable to specialized FRB detectors under zero-shot conditions, and can be flexibly adapted to multi-class tasks by simply rewriting prompts without retraining.
